title: KariAlgorithm struct missing #[non_exhaustive]
description: KariAlgorithm is a public struct passed from the crate to DecryptionKey::agree_ecdh implementors. It has no #[non_exhaustive] annotation. Callers outside the crate can construct it today (KariAlgorithm { key_agreement: ..., key_wrap: ... }), which means adding any new field later is a semver-breaking change. Since callers receive this struct from the crate but should not construct it themselves, #[non_exhaustive] costs nothing in practice and future-proofs the API before it fossilizes.
